title: High-pressure-gas piping.
officialText:
High-pressure-gas piping regulated in Section 406 of the New York City Fuel Gas Code shall be
subject to special inspection in accordance with this section. Special inspection of seismic bracing shall be performed in accordance
with Section 1707.7.
